from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im=np.asarray(Image.open('barcode.png').convert('RGB'))
a=im.mean(axis=0)
print(im.shape)
print('rgb means',a.mean(axis=0),'range',a.min(),a.max())
x=a.mean(axis=1)
for i in range(0,len(x),50):print(i,round(x[i:i+50].mean(),1),round(x[i:i+50].min(),1),round(x[i:i+50].max(),1))
